description: Query and track transaction status for invoice payments. Provides real-time status updates on payment processing, completion, and failure states.
instructions: Access API documentation at https://developer.link4.tech/openapi.json. Use OAuth2 token authentication by sending POST to /token with credentials, then use Bearer token for API calls.

api_name: SAP Concur Purchase Order Receipts API
description: Complete CRUD operations for purchase order receipts. Handles invoice creation, validation, transformation, and communication workflows with full lifecycle management.
instructions: Register application in SAP Concur Developer Center to get credentials. Make POST to /oauth2/token for access token. Sandbox available at hostname/concur/api/v3.0

description: Transforms business documents into globally compliant formats.
instructions: AWS Step Function setup required to use custom API endpoint.

description: Query document status by message UUID. Returns detailed status information including send/receive progress, timestamps, and participant details for sent and received documents.
instructions: Requires valid JWT token, client ID, and message UUID. Returns status name, audit timestamps, sender/recipient details. Available for both sent and received messages.

description: Comprehensive payment processing API for invoices including hosted payment pages, direct payments, voids, captures, and refunds. Supports full payment lifecycle management for invoice transactions.
instructions: Access API documentation at https://developer.link4.tech/openapi.json. Use OAuth2 token authentication by sending POST to /token with credentials, then use Bearer token for API calls.

description: Manage purchase orders for invoice communication workflows. Supports creating, retrieving, and updating purchase order information for procurement processes.
instructions: Access via api.sap.com, search for 'ConcurInvoicePurchaseOrders'. Register SAP Concur account, apply for developer access, create app for credentials. POST to /oauth2/token for token.

description: Analyse invoice data and validate invoices against industry rule sets such as CII (cross industry invoice) rules and Schematron rules.
instructions: Within the ESS UI, Products-> APIs-> ESS Analyse (Demo)

description: Create, read, update, delete and download PDF files for item-based invoices. Supports full CRUD operations for item invoices with PDF generation capabilities.
instructions: Install local MYOB AccountRight, access http://localhost:8080/AccountRight to view company files. Use default administrator account with Basic Auth authentication.

description: EzzyBills API creates a perfect AP automation solution for your business. Its EzzyBills OCR+ Invoice Capture technology is optimised to process invoices & receipts.
instructions: Within the Ezzybills UI, Integrations->EzzyBills API->(Scroll down) SOAP and REST API links. All endpoints require your API key as a query parameter. Most requests (except login) require the session cookie from the login step.

description: Query PEPPOL participant registration and supported document types via SML/SMP lookup. Validates if participant can receive specific document types before sending.
instructions: Requires valid JWT token, account ID, and participant ID. Returns list of supported document types with process and document type identifiers.

description: Create, read, update, delete and download PDF files for professional service invoices. Complete invoice management for professional billing with PDF generation.
instructions: Install local MYOB AccountRight, access http://localhost:8080/AccountRight to view company files. Use default administrator account with Basic Auth authentication.

api_name: SAP Concur Invoice Payment Service API
description: Handle invoice payment confirmation and provider payment processing. Manages payment status updates and payment confirmation workflows for completed invoices.
instructions: Access via api.sap.com, search for 'Invoice Payment Service'. Register SAP Concur account, request client credentials, POST to oauth2/v0 endpoint for token.

description: Manage payment requests for invoice communication and processing. Supports creating, retrieving, and updating payment request information in procurement workflows.
instructions: Search for 'ConcurInvoicePaymentRequest' on api.sap.com. Register SAP Concur account, apply for developer access, create application to obtain client credentials. Use OAuth2 flow.

description: Query OZEDI account balance in dollars. Provides current account balance information for billing and usage monitoring purposes.
instructions: Requires valid JWT token and account ID. GET request returns current dollar amount balance with audit timestamps.

description: Create, read, update, delete and download PDF files for miscellaneous invoices. Full CRUD operations for miscellaneous billing with PDF export functionality.
instructions: Install local MYOB AccountRight, access http://localhost:8080/AccountRight to view company files. Use default administrator account with Basic Auth authentication.

description: Extracts structured data from unstructured business documents.
instructions: AWS Step Function setup required to use custom API endpoint.

description: Update existing OZEDI client properties including supported document types, company data, and PEPPOL directory information. Modifies SMP and directory entries.
instructions: Requires valid JWT token and client ID. Update company name, business identifiers, contacts, document types, and registration level. Changes reflected in PEPPOL network.

description: Send UBL documents via PEPPOL network to recipients. Validates document structure, processes through OZEDI, and forwards to recipient access points with status tracking.
instructions: Requires valid JWT token, client ID, and upload token. Submit UBL XML document with sender/recipient details. Returns message UUID for status tracking.

description: Setup and manage recurring payments for subscription-based invoicing. Enables automated recurring billing for ongoing services and subscriptions.
instructions: Access API documentation at https://developer.link4.tech/openapi.json. Use OAuth2 token authentication by sending POST to /token with credentials, then use Bearer token for API calls.

description: Allows customers to retrieve organisation's registration information for receiving eInvoices and register an organisation to receive eInvoices using a business number.
instructions: Within the Xero UI, Docs->API reference->enInvoicing API->URLs, Xero eInvoicing API can only be accessed by approved app partners

description: List documents ready for download with RECEIVE_READY status. Optimized for polling new unprocessed documents with sorting and document details extraction.
instructions: Requires valid JWT token and client ID. GET request returns pending messages with document details including invoice number, dates, amounts, and parties. Supports sorting.

description: One-stop e-invoicing solution allowing invoice sending via OpenPeppol, DBNAlliance, legacy EDI networks or email.
instructions: On the Storecove UI, Solutions->E-Invoicing API->(scroll down) API Docs

description: Setup and manage webhook notifications for invoice payment events. Enables real-time notifications for payment status changes, completions, and failures.
instructions: Access API documentation at https://developer.link4.tech/openapi.json. Use OAuth2 token authentication by sending POST to /token with credentials, then use Bearer token for API calls.

description: Allows to send and receive electronic invoices and retrieve data on status changes, invoice history, and more.
instructions: To access the B2Brouter API: 1. Access your account 2. Click Integration option 3. Select B2Brouter API option 4. Use Show API Key option to obtain your API key 5. Access API Documentation

description: Validates electronic documents in compliance with European and international standards.
instructions: AWS Step Function setup required to use custom API endpoint.

description: Register webhook URLs for real-time message status notifications. Supports separate webhooks for sending and receiving document events with HMAC signature verification.
instructions: Requires valid JWT token and account ID. POST request with target URL, type (MESSAGE_STATUS), trigger type (CLIENT/ACCOUNT), and trigger value. Returns secret for HMAC verification.

description: Converts UBL JSON invoices to UBL XML format with intelligent field mapping and missing field detection. Supports flexible JSON schema conversion, invoice analysis for missing required fields, and applying fixes before conversion. Built with TypeScript and Express.
instructions: Three endpoints available: POST /api/convert - converts UBL JSON to UBL XML with missing field detection (body: {processedInvoice: {...}, useFlexibleMapping: true}); POST /api/fix/analyse - analyzes invoice for missing fields (body: {invoiceData: {...}}); POST /api/fix/apply - applies fixes and converts to XML (body: {invoiceData: {...}, fixes: {fieldName: value}}). Default port 3000. Run with npm run dev for development or npm start for production.

description: List and update existing webhook configurations. Manage webhook status, target URLs, and settings for message notification workflows.
instructions: Requires valid JWT token and account ID. GET to list webhooks, PUT with secret to update webhook settings including target URL and enabled status.

description: Create, read, update, delete and download PDF files for service-based invoices. Full service invoice lifecycle management with PDF download capabilities.
instructions: Install local MYOB AccountRight, access http://localhost:8080/AccountRight to view company files. Use default administrator account with Basic Auth authentication.

description: Sends electronic documents across compliant networks including AU PEPPOL.
instructions: AWS Step Function setup required to use custom API endpoint.

description: Validates document formats and contents against ESS rulesets.
instructions: AWS Step Function setup required to use custom API endpoint.

description: Convert UBL invoice documents to PDF format. Provides standardized PDF layout for received invoices with customization options available on request.
instructions: Requires valid JWT token, client ID, and message UUID. Returns PDF document based on UBL XML. Available for both sent and received messages.

description: Delete or disable OZEDI clients from the system. Clients with no message history are deleted, while clients with existing messages are disabled.
instructions: Requires valid JWT token and client ID. DELETE request removes client from system if no messages exist, otherwise disables the client.

description: Download UBL documents received via PEPPOL network. Retrieves documents using message UUID obtained from pending lists or webhook notifications.
instructions: Requires valid JWT token, client ID, and message UUID. Returns UBL XML document. Use pending list or webhooks to identify available messages.

description: Send and receive invoices on the Peppol network using Domibus RESTful API.
instructions: On the Ademico UI, Read REST API Docs->Getting Started->Sending/Receiving Invoices

description: Register new PEPPOL clients for e-invoicing. Creates SML locator, SMP publisher entries, and adds client to OZEDI account. Supports ABN, NZBN, GS1, and DUNS participant identifiers.
instructions: Requires valid JWT token. Provide account number, participant ID, company details, business identifiers, contacts, and supported document types. Configure sending/receiving level.

description: Easily validate Peppol and XML documents such as EN 16931 (e.g., XRechnung), EHF, OIOUBL, A-NZ PEPPOL BIS3, CII Cross-Industry Invoice, OpenPEPPOL formats, various UBL file types, and many more.
instructions: On ECOSIO UI, Menu->Resources->Peppol/XML Validator->Book a Demo

description: Performs intelligent invoice extraction and returns JSON/XML formats.
instructions: AWS Step Function setup required to use custom API endpoint.

description: Create and manage purchase requests for procurement workflows. Supports POST for creation and GET for retrieval of purchase request data and status.
instructions: Register for SAP BTP Cockpit, obtain client_id and client_secret, make POST request to /oauth2/token to get access token. Use token in Authorization header for API calls.

description: Acknowledge receipt of documents and optionally send business level responses. Changes message status to RECEIVE_DELIVERED and can generate INVOICE_RESPONSE_3 documents.
instructions: Requires valid JWT token, client ID, and message UUID. Optional request body for business level responses with response codes (AB, IP, UQ, CA, RE, AP, PD).

description: Retrieve detailed validation error reports for failed documents. Provides PEPPOL and UBL validation errors with error codes, descriptions, and document locations.
instructions: Requires valid JWT token and message UUID. Returns detailed error list with codes, descriptions, and locations. Available for both sent and received message validation.

description: Extract and download embedded attachments from UBL documents. Supports various file types including PDF, spreadsheets, images, and CSV. Multiple attachments returned as ZIP archive.
instructions: Requires valid JWT token, client ID, and message UUID. Returns binary file content. Available for both sent (/snd/) and received (/rcv/) messages.

description: Generate upload tokens for document sending. Validates recipient PEPPOL registration, checks SMP document type support, and verifies account balance before token generation.
instructions: Requires valid JWT token and client ID. Provide sender, recipient PEPPOL IDs, process ID, and document type. Token valid for 24 hours, single use only.

description: Search and filter messages by sender, recipient, document type, date range, and status. Provides comprehensive message history and filtering capabilities for both sent and received documents.
instructions: Requires valid JWT token and client ID. POST request with filter criteria including sender, recipient, document category, date range, and message status. Default returns 20 records.

description: Authenticate users and obtain JWT tokens for OZEDI e-invoicing platform access. Provides 24-hour valid authentication tokens for subsequent API calls.
instructions: Send POST request with OZEDI username and password. Use returned JWT token in Authorization header for all subsequent API calls. Token valid for 24 hours.

description: Securely sends invoices and business documents via AU PEPPOL network.
instructions: AWS Step Function setup required to use custom API endpoint.

description: Submits invoice documents to Avalara E-Invoicing and Live Reporting for country-specific formatting, validation, and transmission workflows.
instructions: POST an invoice document to the sandbox endpoint with the Avalara version, client header, and Bearer token; use the returned document ID to track processing.

description: Accepts an encoded invoice document for Sovos processing, validation, routing, and country-specific e-invoicing compliance.
instructions: Obtain an OAuth 2.0 client-credentials token, then POST a JSON body containing a Base64-encoded source business document.
business_rules: Country-specific semantic, syntactic and legal validation

description: Handles business documents sent from and received into Pagero Online, including invoices and related document flows.
instructions: Replace region and version with the values assigned for the Pagero tenant; call the REST document collection with an OAuth 2.0 access token.

description: Sends structured invoice data to Basware Network and supports retrieving received invoice documents and notifications.
instructions: Generate a unique BUM ID, then POST the invoice as JSON with the system-account credentials and X-BW-REQUEST-ID header.
business_rules: Unique BUM ID and request ID required

api_name: Billit Send UBL to Peppol API
description: Validates a UBL invoice against Peppol rules and sends compliant documents into the Peppol network.
instructions: POST JSON containing the UBL XML; include PartyID and OAuth access token (or an API key only for permitted non-commercial integrations).

description: Creates an accounts-receivable invoice with customer, line-item, tax, classification, and payment options in BILL.
instructions: POST a JSON invoice request to the stage endpoint with the sessionId returned by /v3/login and the BILL developer key.

description: Creates draft invoices in FreshBooks and supports subsequent marking, emailing, updating, and payment workflows.
instructions: POST a JSON invoice object with a Bearer token that includes the user:invoices:write scope; specify invoice numbers when creating concurrently.
business_rules: Invoice number uniqueness for concurrent creation

description: Creates a draft customer invoice in Stripe before finalization, payment collection, or delivery to the customer.
instructions: POST form-encoded invoice parameters using the Stripe secret key; finalize or send the returned draft invoice in a later call.

description: Creates a draft Square invoice linked to an order, with recipient, delivery, scheduling, and payment-request settings.
instructions: POST a JSON invoice with a Bearer access token and idempotency key; an order must already exist before the draft can be created.

description: Creates, retrieves, updates, and deletes receivables invoices in Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials.
instructions: Replace the server and region placeholders with the Oracle Cloud tenant values, then POST a JSON invoice using an allowed SSL authentication method.
authentication_method: Basic over SSL, SAML 2.0, or JWT
